scenario.test: does not revive remote-content consent after switching between mounted thread messages
scenario.securityProperty: A remote-content grant expires when a thread row is collapsed, so returning to that mounted row cannot restore the previous message's remote image without a new explicit action.

mutation.description: Removed only the collapse effect that clears remoteContentAllowedFor.
mutation.expectedBrokenOutcome: After allowing remote content for message A, expanding message B, and expanding A again, A's remote image retains its src without renewed consent.

commands.command: NODE_OPTIONS=--localstorage-file=/private/tmp/dakia-reader-remote-sensitivity-localstorage npm test -- --run apps/desktop/src/components/Reader.test.tsx -t 'does not revive remote-content consent after switching between mounted thread messages'

mutant.failure: Reader.test.tsx:352 expected the re-expanded A image to have no src, but received true.

limitations: This is a jsdom component sensitivity test. Native WebKit network and iframe behavior require separate acceptance evidence.
